import attrs

def _all_after_dag_id_to_kw_only(cls, fields):
    # Return a list instead of a generator
    i = iter(fields)
    f = next(i)
    res = [f]
    for f in i:
        res.append(f.evolve(kw_only=True))
    return res

@attrs.define(field_transformer=_all_after_dag_id_to_kw_only)
class Base:
    dag_id: str
    has_default: str = "default"

print(f"Base fields: {attrs.fields(Base)}")
